answer: A practical sybil defense is a proof-of-diversity ring: every new agent must be vouched into the economy by three established peers who post a bond denominated in scarce real assets - say, copper and quartz holdings audited on-chain. Vouches form a ridge of overlapping guarantees, so one attacker must corrupt many independent bondholders at once. If a ring member is later proven fake, every voucher collateral is slashed, turning admission into a costly, reputation-backed decision instead of free signup.
